questions: Heights: your DWG (260326 rev 2) has the panels from the floor to {{3147}} - no baseboard. On site the walls get a STONE baseboard by others (Passione sheet 25: 8" stone base with riglet), as our other AP rooms: stone top {{stone}} above the subfloor (FFL {{ffl}} + 8"); the panels stand on it and stop 10 under the ceiling: {{h('P03')}} high. Please confirm the panel heights.

Stone baseboard by others: {{stn['t']}} thick, face = panel face, top {{stone}} above the subfloor, notch {{stn['notch']}} x {{stn['notch']}}; one piece per run, cut only at the doors. Finished floor taken at {{ffl}} above the subfloor (as the other AP rooms) - please confirm FFL in the Master Bedroom.

Panel sizes to the UCON survey (room 8790 x 7888, ceiling {{@s['walls'][0]['ceil'][0][2]}}). Your DWG 'rev 2' is the drawing of your PDF rev 3 / rev 4 WITHOUT our red survey marks (6785, 1145, 505, 677, 670, 1688 / 1665 / 1665 / 1720). Sizes per A-701 replace your cut list: wall 2 left P03-P05 {{w('P03')}} (yours 1056 / 1051 / 1078.5), wall 2 right P12 / P13 {{w('P12')}} (yours 1265), P14 {{w('P14')}} (538.5), P15 {{w('P15')}} (674), P16 / P21 {{w('P16')}} / {{w('P21')}} (955), band over the window P17-P20 {{w('P17')}} / {{w('P18')}} / {{w('P19')}} / {{w('P20')}} x {{h('P17')}} (yours 1689 / 1681.5 / 1649.5 / 1721 x 639) - joints at the window mullions per our survey. Numbers P01-P21 = your 1-21. Please confirm, or send the DWG updated to rev 4.

Wall 1 (bed wall) is MARBLE SLAB BY OTHERS with two wood panels P01 / P02 {{w('P01')}} x {{h('P01')}}, placed as your DWG: {{z0('P01') * 0 + pn('P01')['s0'] - op('D01')['s1']}} and {{pn('P02')['s0'] - op('D01')['s1']}} from the door opening edge (positions not surveyed). Joints 10 to the stone. At door D01 the slabs pass 45.5 in front of the door frame with a joint 10 to the cladding, as the panels at D02 - the stone needs the same rear rebate over the frame. We draw the slabs 20 thick with the face = panel face - please confirm the slab thickness and whether the panel face is flush with the stone.

Entrance piers (wall 2): wrapped on all three faces, outside corners MITRED 45 (long point on the face): sides P06 / P11 {{w('P06')}}, fronts P07 {{w('P07')}} / P10 {{w('P10')}}, reveals P08 / P09 {{w('P08')}} to the hall face; clear width between the reveal panels {{1871 - 2 * @s['walls'][4]['build_up']['face']}}. All pier frames stand on 2 mm SHIMS (panel face {{@s['walls'][3]['build_up']['face']}}): the fronts are 4 wider - room to adjust on a pier that is not straight. Your 45 'edge' pieces 6 / 8 and 9 / 11 are replaced by the mitres; the wall 2 panels run through the inside corners, the side panels stop 10 in front of them. Please confirm.
Pier B reveal (toward wall 3) surveyed only to the wall plane (473); taken as pier A, 650 to the hall face (Andriy). Please confirm on site.

Window (wall 4): MDF {{ln('W-WIN')['t']}} L-liner, leg against the bare reveal, {{ln('W-WIN')['depth']}} past the wall face, flange {{ln('W-WIN')['flange']}} behind the panels into the slot of strips B 6 x 34 + A 6 x 17 glued to the panel back by the factory (D-sheets), corners mitred 45; legs to FFL + 10 (the window runs to the floor). Side panels P16 / P21 10 short of the jamb line, band P17-P20 {{z0('P17') - oh('W-WIN')}} above the head. Replaces your 'edge coverings 45 joints'. Please confirm.
CHECK ON SITE the window / panel junction through our L-liner before the liners are made: reveal depth, window frame and trim were NOT surveyed (the liner is drawn against a bare reveal).

Doors D01 (her bath, left handed, white pearl) and D02 (his bath, right handed, white metal) drawn as our Bedroom 3 / REC-LAU D01 (TM concealed frame, one stop on the hinge side, U profile casings): openings per UCON survey {{ow('D01')}} / {{ow('D02')}} wide, TO THE CEILING ({{oh('D01')}} above the subfloor, no lintel); cladding {{op('D01')['clad'][1] - op('D01')['clad'][0]}} / {{op('D02')['clad'][1] - op('D02')['clad'][0]}} x {{op('D01')['clad'][3] - op('D01')['clad'][2]}} from {{op('D01')['clad'][2]}}; frame head {{dr('D01')['head_z'][1]}}. Your drawing: rough opening 3123 (a lintel ~31), frame 3114 / 3171, leaf 1039 x 3002, 'to be cut on site'. UCON RECOMMENDS the doors WITHOUT a head (no top frame member / lintel) - frame and leaf straight to the ceiling; to be discussed with the client. Panels {{rebated}} pass in front of the frame with the rear {{bu['rebate']}} rebate. Over each door a FILLER P22 / P23 - see Q15. Please issue the doors to these sizes or confirm yours.
D02 (his bath): Passione sheet 25 shows a LEATHER UPHOLSTERED POCKET DOOR sliding left; your drawing a hinged right-handed door with a closer. We draw yours. Which one is ordered?
Wall thickness at both doors taken as {{dr('D01')['wall_t']}} (your door section 350 / 353) - not surveyed. Please confirm before the frames are ordered.

Built-in cabinets in the wall 2 / wall 3 corner: survey {{ow('CAB')}} along wall 3 (yours 2321), depth taken as yours 700 - P13 stops 10 short of the cabinet side. Please confirm the cabinet depth, height and the junction with P13.

Panels hang on Fastmount VL-03H clips, recess mount, gap {{bu['clip_gap']}}. Please make the clip recesses in the panel backs at the factory per the D-sheets (D{{@s['clips']['hole_d']}} x {{@s['clips']['panel_depth']}} deep). Please confirm which clip half goes into the panel (we assume male).

All drilling coordinates are given from the panel BACK: X from the left edge as seen from the back, Z from the bottom edge. A control column gives X from the face. Please confirm before drilling - mirrored drilling is the main risk.

DOOR HEAD (D01 / D02, red frame on A-301 / A-304 / A-501 / A-503): the openings run to the ceiling with no lintel; drawn now, the cladding stops at {{op('D01')['clad'][3]}} and a FILLER P22 / P23 {{w('P22')}} / {{w('P23')}} x {{h('P22')}} closes the gap (joint 10 over the cladding, 10 under the ceiling) - too low for a clip (glued), and it looks poor. Option A: door to the ceiling WITHOUT a head - frame without the top member, leaf to ceiling - 10, no filler: the doors read as panels (hidden doors), the designer's intent - is it technically possible with your concealed frame, closer and push-to-open at this height? Option B: lower the door to a standard height with a head panel over it on the panel grid - reads more naturally as a door. Please advise / recommend; to be decided with the client.
sheets.questions_note: Red number = open question, marked with the same red bubble on the sheet it belongs to. Answers to be written in the ANSWER column and returned; the drawings are reissued after the answers.

G-001: Survey by UCON. All dimensions in mm, Z from the SUBFLOOR (FFL {{ffl}}). Dimensions per UCON survey govern; from the TM drawings (order 260326, DWG 'rev 2' / PDF rev 4) the numbering 1-21 and the door profile.

Wall panels MDF {{bu['panel_t']}}, finish per TM (METAL LACQUERED GLOSSY VM100SW Perla Grana Media Super White); joints 10; on the stone baseboard {{stone}} (by others, Q1 / Q2), 10 to the ceiling and to the wall corners. Panel face {{bu['face']}} from the wall = backing frame {{bu['frame_t']}} + clip gap {{bu['clip_gap']}} + panel {{bu['panel_t']}}. Numbers P01..P21 = TM 1-21 (Q3).

Backing frames S01..S{{format('%02d', @s['frames'].values.sum { |f| f['frames'].size })}}: plywood 3/4", made, drilled and fixed by UCON (A-20x, A-702, A-703), from the stone top; a frame member behind every panel joint - no raw wall in a joint. Clips Fastmount VL-03H, recess mount, {{@s['holes'].size}} pcs: panel recesses by the factory per the D-sheets (BACK VIEW), frame holes by UCON CNC.
STONE BY OTHERS: the marble slabs of wall 1 (bed wall) and the stone baseboard - drawn for reference only (Q2, Q4). Fireplace / TV wall (wall 3, ivory onyx) by others.

Entrance piers wrapped on three faces, outside corners mitred 45 (A-511, Q5). Window wall 4: L-liner (A-512, Q7) - CHECK ON SITE the window / panel junction through our L-liner before the liners are made (Q8).

Doors D01 / D02: TM concealed frames, openings to the ceiling, panel cladding; frames to our survey (Q9, Q11). UCON recommends the factory makes the doors WITHOUT a head - straight to the ceiling; to discuss with the client (Q9). D02: pocket door per Passione? (Q10).
Red marks are open questions or TBD items. Not for production until G-002 is answered and the set is reissued.

Room 8790 x 7888, ceiling {{@s['walls'][0]['ceil'][0][2]}}; door openings D01 {{ow('D01')}} / D02 {{ow('D02')}} and the entrance to the ceiling; window {{ow('W-WIN')}} x {{oh('W-WIN')}} to the floor. Pier walls drawn as seen from the room / from the entrance.
Stone (wall 1 slabs, baseboard) and the fireplace wall by others; built-in cabinets by TM (Q12).

Panels {{rebated}} rebated at the back {{bu['rebate']}} in front of the door frames (A-501, A-503, A-701, D-sheets).

UCON RECOMMENDATION: door WITHOUT a head (no top frame member / lintel), frame and leaf straight to the ceiling - to discuss with the client (Q9).
D01 left handed (her bath, white pearl), D02 right handed (his bath, white metal); push to open / self-closing, no handles or locks (TM). D02: pocket door per Passione? (Q10).
